inputs.share_count_basis: 505,769,256 ordinary shares in issue at 30 July 2026 (Q2-26 earnings release, no treasury shares) plus ~1.1m dilutive awards (H1-26 diluted EPS 447c vs basic 448c, ~0.2%). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The $2bn buyback approved 23 July 2026 is not credited: under the house method buybacks are value-neutral (cash already charged).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F statement of changes in equity: equity-settled share-based payments $40m (FY24 $28m, FY23 $15m per Note 8/9). No net-share-settlement tax line disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 in kpis).
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows (gold is USD-priced; statements in USD). Cost of equity ~10.8% = 4.3% US 10y + 1.0 beta x 5.0% ERP + ~1.5% blended country-risk premium for ~70% of production in Ghana, DRC, Tanzania, Guinea, Egypt; company is net cash so WACC ~ cost of equity, rounded to 10.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: gold-price and jurisdiction risk live in the scenario flows and weights, not in a stacked premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): lease cash cost (FY25 principal $92m + interest $17m = $109m, 1.1% of revenue) charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path at 1.0%; lease liabilities ($207m at 30-Jun-26) EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows made attributable: the cash_tax_rate_path is a combined leakage of ~29-30% cash tax plus ~17% NCI share of post-tax profit (mainly the Egyptian state's Sukari profit share; FY25 NCI $538m = 18.4% of post-tax profit ex-JV, H1-26 $371m = 15.9%). 1-(1-0.29)(1-0.17) = 41%. Calibration: FY25 modelled NOPAT ~$2.45bn vs attributable NI ex-Kibali and ex-items ~$2.5bn. NCI book equity ($1,783m) is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF with a mid-cycle gold-price normalisation (cyclical-producer adaptation), the same family as BSL.AX/FCX/CMM.AX. AU is a large established producer ($9.9bn FY25 revenue, ~3.0 Moz/yr) - NOT the pre-revenue miner template. Revenue paths are derived from a per-ounce build: managed gold sold x realised price + ~$160m by-products; EBITDA = revenue - oz x (cash cost ex-royalty + royalty% x price) - ~$500m corporate/exploration/other. FY25 actual: 2.81 Moz managed sold at $3,466/oz, EBITDA margin ~55.6% ex-Kibali. FY26: H1 realised $4,650/oz, Q2 $4,446; guidance 2.8-3.17 Moz group, TCC $1,315-1,430/oz, AISC $1,780-1,990/oz at $4,250 gold. Base price glide $4,400 (FY26) -> $4,000 -> $3,700 -> $3,500 (FY29) then +2%/yr nominal; i.e. mid-cycle ~20% below today's ~$4,000-4,500 spot. Kibali (45% JV, equity-accounted, outside revenue) valued separately in the equity bridge. Interest income is 0 in the owner-FCF bridge because interest received ($92m FY25) is classified in INVESTING, not OCF, so OCF-capex never contained it; net cash ($1.2bn) is < 1x the FCF base anyway. reported_fcf = OCF 4,784 - capex 1,449 (FY25, before $397m-type NCI distributions and lease payments, which the forward build charges). Balance sheet anchors from the Q2-26 earnings release (6-K 31-Jul-2026, Note E): borrowings $1,571m (non-current 1,559 + current 12, after the $666m April-2026 bond buyback), cash $2,769m; company-defined net cash incl. leases $991m. Buyback: none executed through H1-26; the $2bn programme is an authorisation, so buyback_cash = 0 and the flat share count is a modelling convention not yet funded.

equity_bridge.note: ~7x a mid-cycle attributable share of profit of ~$230m (FY24 $155m at $2,393/oz; FY25 $255m at $3,466/oz; H1-26 $325m at ~$4,650/oz). Book carrying value of associates/JVs $726m (FY25). Held constant across scenarios.
FY25 balance sheet $200m non-current + $133m current, less $66m repaid in H1-26

equity_bridge.item: Q2-26 interim dividend declared, paid after balance-sheet date
equity_bridge.note: 72c/share, ex-dividend NYSE 21-Aug-2026, paid 4-Sep-2026: in the 30-Jun cash balance but not owned by today's buyer
FY25 balance sheet non-current provision; debt-like closure liability not inside the 10-year flows

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: none of the historical CAGRs - all are gold-price-cycle artefacts; long-run nominal growth set at ~2% (gold price inflation, flat volumes) after an explicit per-ounce glide
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 16.8% is in line with revenue 16.6% and EPS 17.0%, but every series is dominated by the gold price moving from ~$1,770/oz (FY20) to $3,466/oz (FY25) plus the Nov-2024 Centamin acquisition (share-funded, 421m -> 505m shares, and +$1.9bn NCI). They describe a commodity up-cycle, not a compounding rate, and are not used as forward growth.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = OCF - capex - SBC (equity-award taxes nil; interest received is in investing). Owner-FCF CAGR (63% 3yr) far exceeds revenue CAGR: operating leverage of a high-cost producer to the gold price, i.e. the reason not to extrapolate it. SBC is <0.5% of revenue and is not growing faster than cash flow.

base.narrative: Gold $4,400 FY26 (H1 locked at $4,650) gliding to a $3,500 mid-cycle by FY29, then +2%/yr nominal. Managed volumes 2.67 Moz FY26 (post Cuiaba sale, Obuasi KMS shaft closure) rising to 3.0 Moz by FY31 on Obuasi's ramp to 400koz and early Nevada. Cash cost ex-royalty $1,140/oz inflating 3%/yr then 2.5%; royalties 6% of price falling to 5% at mid-cycle. Capex elevated at ~$2.0bn FY26-28 (Obuasi, Nevada, reserve development) then ~$1.7bn sustaining+growth growing with inflation.
base.da_note: Dollar path 1,230 / 1,280 / 1,330 / 1,380 / 1,400 then +2.5%/yr, ex right-of-use depreciation (FY25 D&A $1,287m incl ROU)

bull.narrative: Today's regime persists: gold $4,450 FY26 rising to $4,700 by FY29 then +2%/yr (central-bank buying ~750t/yr, real-rate cuts, the bank forecasts of $4,900-5,400 only partly realised). Volumes 2.68 -> 3.15 Moz on Obuasi at 400koz+ (Block 11), Sukari expansion approved and Nevada in production by FY29. Royalties at the 6.5% sliding-scale ceiling; capex ~$100-150m/yr higher for growth.

bear.narrative: Gold mean-reverts: $4,300 FY26, $3,500 FY27, $3,000 FY28, $2,800 FY29 then +2%/yr (rates higher for longer, geopolitical de-escalation, central-bank buying slows). As the highest-cost major (Q2-26 AISC $2,039/oz) AU's margin compresses fastest. Obuasi ramp stalls after the KMS shaft closure and Ghana's December-2026 local-contractor mandate; volumes stuck ~2.7 Moz. Growth capex is cut to ~$1.5bn but cost inflation (fuel, labour, royalties) is sticky. Leakage rises to 43% as low-cost Sukari (with its state profit share) is a larger share of profit.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle normalisation. The FY25-26 margins are a gold-price windfall on an above-average cost base, so the base case glides the realised price from ~$4,400 to a $3,500/oz mid-cycle (still above every annual average before FY25) while volumes recover to ~3.0 Moz on Obuasi and early Nevada. EBITDA margin falls from ~64% to ~55%, the FY25 level, and owner FCF settles around $2.1-2.5bn a year after cash tax and the Sukari NCI leakage.
scenario_narratives.bull: The new gold regime is structural: central-bank reserve diversification and debased fiat keep gold at ~$4,500-4,700 and rising with inflation, Obuasi reaches 400koz with Block 11 grades, Sukari's mine-life extension is approved by MRMIA and Nevada adds a lower-risk production centre. Margins hold ~63% and owner FCF compounds toward $4.5bn.
scenario_narratives.bear: The gold rally unwinds toward ~$2,800/oz as real rates stay high and safe-haven demand fades; AU, the highest-cost major with no hedge book, sees margins fall to ~44%. Resource nationalism (Ghana's 5-12% sliding royalty and local-contractor mandate, DRC/Tanzania local-content rules, Egyptian fiscal terms) and recurring Obuasi safety incidents cap volumes near 2.7 Moz. Owner FCF falls to ~$1.1-1.2bn.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (above the 15% default): unhedged, highest-cost major whose value is a leveraged bet on a gold price at all-time highs, with live African resource-nationalism and Obuasi execution risk. Base 50%: a partial mean reversion is the historical norm after gold spikes. Bull 25% (below the 35% default): the bull needs gold to hold record levels for a decade AND three growth projects to deliver, several independent things going right.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value AU as a mid-cycle gold producer, not at the FY25-26 peak. Revenue is ounces x gold price, so the forward path is built per ounce and the gold price is normalised toward a mid-cycle level rather than extrapolated. Tax and the Sukari NCI are charged once in a combined leakage rate, Kibali sits in the bridge as a separate asset, leases are charged in the flows, and closure liabilities are deducted. A 10x terminal cap reflects a depleting-asset business that must spend to replace reserves.
key_risks_to_valuation: Gold price: every $100/oz on ~2.8 Moz is ~$280m of pre-tax EBITDA (~$165m after leakage); the value is first and foremost a gold-price call, and the market price implies roughly today's spot persisting
Cost inflation and royalties: AISC rose to $2,039/oz in Q2-26; gold-linked royalties (Ghana sliding scale to 12%) mean costs rise with price
Jurisdiction: Ghana, DRC, Tanzania, Guinea and Egypt fiscal terms; Sukari profit-share renegotiation with MRMIA
Execution: Obuasi ramp after the April-2026 fatality and KMS shaft closure; Nevada development capex and timing
Capital allocation: a $2bn buyback executed at peak-gold prices would destroy value on this model's mid-cycle basis
